items.title: Army helicopter to rescue six Indian tourists stranded by snow in Dolpa
items.blurb: The tourists are stranded in Danigad of Shey Phoksundo Rural Municipality as several days of heavy snowfall disrupt life in the high Himalayan region.

items.title: Ground staff prepare for Saturday’s second match of NPL despite rain
items.blurb: Biratnagar Kings and Sudurpaschim Royals are likely to take the field after the opening fixture between Lumbini Lions and Chitwan Rhinos was abandoned without a toss.

items.title: Rising Kulekhani reservoir prompts flood alert along Bagmati river
items.blurb: Rautahat authorities warn riverside residents to prepare for possible sudden rises in water levels if water is released from the reservoir in neighbouring Makwanpur district.

items.title: Rain washes out Lumbini-Chitwan match on Saturday
items.blurb: Persistent rain leaves Lumbini Lions and Chitwan Rhinos with a point each, while the Biratnagar Kings-Sudurpaschim Royals match is also in doubt.

items.title: Rain triggers landslides, washes away roads and disrupts travel across Nepal
items.blurb: Landslides have disrupted the Prithvi Highway, washed away a road diversion in Gorkha and buried a house in Kavre, while heavy snow has hit the Kanchenjunga region.
